Around [[3640 BBY]], during the [[Galactic War]], the [[Rift Alliance]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tobas Grell]] was kidnapped by [[Stark]], a servant of the [[Syo Bakarn|First Son of the Emperor]]. The [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and Tobas's daughter [[Nadia Grell]], tried to '''rescue''' Tobas, but the man succumbed to Stark's [[Torture/Legends|torture]]. Stark was defeated and died when his life was cut off by the First Son.<ref name="TOR:F" />
